item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 3 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 #VISPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 11:00 PM 17 August 2026

Red Warning: #OccidentalMindoro
Associated Hazard: SERIOUS FLOODING is expected in low-lying areas and LANDSLIDES in mountainous areas.

Orange Warning: #Iloilo(Guimbal, Oton, IloiloCity, Leganes, Pavia, Zarraga, Dumangas, SanMiguel, SantaBarbara and Tigbauan)
Associated Hazard: FLOODING IS THREATENING in low-lying areas and LANDSLIDES in mountainous areas.

Yellow Warning: #Palawan(Coron, Busuanga, Culion), #Iloilo(Alimodian, Leon, Miagao, SanJoaquin, NewLucena, Pototan, BarotacNuevo, Tubungan, Igbaras, Cabatuan), #Antique(AniniY, TobiasFornier, Hamtic, SanJose, Sibalom), #NegrosOccidental(CadizCity, Manapla, CityOfVictorias, EnriqueB.Magalona, SilayCity, CityOfTalisay) and #Guimaras
Associated Hazard: FLOODING IS POSSIBLE in low-lying areas and LANDSLIDES in mountainous areas.

Meanwhile, Light to Moderate with occasionally Heavy rains are expected over #Palawan(SanVicente, Roxas), #Antique(Belison, Bugasong, LauaAn, Patnongon, SanRemigio, Valderrama), #NegrosOccidental(Murcia, Pulupandan, BagoCity, Toboso, CityOfEscalante, Calatrava, SalvadorBenedicto and SanCarlosCity) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Palawan(Cuyo, Magsaysay, Agutaya, Dumaran, Araceli, Taytay, ElNido, Linapacan, Cagayancillo), #Aklan(Nabas, Malay, Buruanga, Ibajay, Tangalan, Makato, Malinao, Madalag), #Iloilo(Janiuay, Maasin, Mina, BarotacViejo, Banate, Anilao, Dingle, Badiangan, Dueñas, SanEnrique, SanRafael, Ajuy, Concepcion, SanDionisio, Sara, Lemery), #Antique(Barbaza, Caluya, Culasi, Libertad, Pandan, Sebaste, Tibiao), #NegrosOccidental(BacolodCity, SagayCity) and #Biliran which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 02:00 AM Tomorrow.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 20 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 20 #VISPRSD
Issued at 11:21 PM 17 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Siquijor(Larena, EnriqueVillanueva), #NegrosOriental(Amlan and SanJose) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NegrosOriental(SantaCatalina, Siaton), #Siquijor(Lazi, Maria), #Leyte(Tabango, Leyte, Villaba and Capoocan) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
